recipe.visualDefinition: A candid, warm-toned portrait of a man in a white t-shirt leaning on a diner counter, framed by illustrative dashed road lines and contrasting typographic styles that suggest a journey.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed away from the camera toward the left frame
Typographic elements following the perspective of the hand-drawn dashed lines
Warm interior lighting contrasting with bright, overexposed window light
Red interior walls echoing the primary color of the display text
coreInvariants: Hand-drawn black dashed lines forming a corner frame
Subject wearing a plain white v-neck or crew neck t-shirt
Diner setting with visible counter and background windows
Two-font typographic hierarchy with a heavy slab serif and a fluid script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, medium shot, leaning forward on a wooden counter.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smiling face and the intersection of the dashed lines in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red display text, follows the horizontal dashed line to the right, drops down the vertical dashed line, and settles on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper left and center, occupied by the ceiling and lighting fixtures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and beige (ceiling, counter, shirt) providing a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red (walls and display text) providing warmth and visual pop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black (dashed lines and script text) for structural definition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key lighting with soft shadows; colors are naturalistic with a slight warm tint.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif for display; rhythmic cursive for subtitle.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky serifs with minimal stroke contrast.
Subtitle text uses a connected script with a consistent slant and medium weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Display text is rotated approximately 5 degrees counter-clockwise to match the road line angle.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, masculine slab serif and fluid, organic script.
graphicDevices: Hand-drawn charcoal-style dashed lines forming a 'road' border.

avoid: Clean vector lines for the dashes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif display style.
Captures the casual, rhythmic flow of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a smiling man with short brown hair wearing a white t-shirt, leaning his arms on a wooden diner counter. The background shows a diner interior with red walls, large windows, and fluorescent ceiling lights. The lighting is warm and natural.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a hand-drawn black dashed line that starts at the top right, goes down vertically, and another that goes horizontally across the top. Place large red all-caps slab serif text at a slight upward angle in the top left. Place black lowercase script text horizontally in the center right, nestled under the dashed line.

verificationChecks: Is the display text red and angled?
Are the dashed lines textured like charcoal or crayon?
Is the subject leaning on a counter?
Is the script text entirely lowercase?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red wall color
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the individual
Ensure the dashed lines look hand-drawn rather than perfect geometric rectangles

avoid: Perfectly straight vector lines for the road motif

postGenerationChecks: Check that the slab serif text does not overlap the subject's head.
Ensure the dashed lines appear to have a rough, tactile texture.
Verify the color of the display text matches the red of the diner walls.
Confirm the script text is legible against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Candid diner portrait + Hand-drawn road motifs + Slab serif/Script typographic pairing.
